title: Assessing cotton boll-opening concentration for harvest decision-making via foundation model-enhanced cross-scale phenotyping

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Assessing cotton boll-opening concentration for harvest decision-making via foundation model-enhanced cross-scale phenotyping》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Boll-opening concentration is critical for mechanical cotton harvesting, yet it is still assessed mainly by manual records and single time-point indicators that miss temporal dynamics.

evidence.text: Boll-opening concentration is critical for mechanical cotton harvesting, yet it is still assessed mainly by manual records and single time-point indicators that miss temporal dynamics.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Assessing cotton boll-opening concentration for harvest decision-making via foundation model-enhanced cross-scale phenotyping》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Under unified data and training settings, DINO-BollGX achieved precision = 0.91, F1 = 0.88, and AP@0.50 = 0.80, and provided accurate boll-count estimation (R2 = 0.98; MAE = 3.10), outperforming YOLOv11, YOLOv12, YOLOv13, and RT-DETR.
